# Public Homelab Copilot Skills

These skills add public-homelab context to the [generic DevHub skills](https://github.com/CollinPoetoehena/DevHub/tree/main/.github/skills). They have distinct names from the private repository's skills, so their publication assumptions are not confused.

| Skill | Use |
|---|---|
| [homelab-public-project](./homelab-public-project/SKILL.md) | Generic knowledge-base scope, content ownership and publication boundary |
| [homelab-public-docs](./homelab-public-docs/SKILL.md) | Homelab-focused documentation layered on DevHub `docs` |
| [homelab-public-implement-change](./homelab-public-implement-change/SKILL.md) | Public changes layered on DevHub `implement-change`, without importing live setup |
| [homelab-sanitize](./homelab-sanitize/SKILL.md) | Explicitly generalize private lessons for safe publication |

Invoke `/homelab-public-project` for context, `/homelab-public-docs` for documentation, `/homelab-public-implement-change` for changes, and `/homelab-sanitize` for publication preparation. See [repository guidelines](../../docs/Repository_Guidelines.md) for the source-of-truth policy.

Open this repository as a workspace root, or add both repositories as separate roots in a multi-root workspace. Verify the skills are available and invoke the one matching the target repository. [Private skills](https://github.com/CollinPoetoehena/devhub-homelab-private/blob/main/.github/skills/README.md) are for actual implementation records, not public output.

A GitHub link does **not** install a skill. Install/make the generic workflow available using the [DevHub skill guidance](https://github.com/CollinPoetoehena/DevHub/blob/main/.github/skills/README.md) and [AI reference](https://github.com/CollinPoetoehena/DevHub/blob/main/reference/AI.md#coding-github-copilot-in-vs-code), or read the linked workflow when accessible. Keep generic workflows in DevHub; do not maintain divergent copies here.
